segments.t: La lluvia golpea las ventanas del vestíbulo en la posada Linden Courtyard Inn, en Portland. Con un segundo huésped para la habitación siete a punto de llegar en treinta y cinco minutos, Arthur, Hannah y Graham se apresuran hacia la escalera. Escucha primero toda la escena en inglés.
Thirty-five minutes! He will write a terrible one star review!
Take a deep breath, Arthur. Nobody has written anything yet.
Here is the small silver key for the third floor attic door.
Does the attic even have a proper bed?
Yes, a good wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the house.
Then why do we never rent it to guests?
Because the stairs are narrow and Arthur keeps old lamp boxes there.
Only three small boxes! Maybe four!
We can move four boxes in five minutes. Let us go look right now!
Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the top.
I will bring clean white sheets from the linen closet!
Come on, race you to the third floor!
Ahora repasemos la conversación con calma, frase por frase.
Thirty-five minutes! He will write a terrible one star review!
'¡Treinta y cinco minutos! ¡Escribirá una reseña terrible de una estrella!'
Take a deep breath, Arthur. Nobody has written anything yet.
'Respira hondo, Arthur. Todavía nadie ha escrito nada.'
Here is the small silver key for the third floor attic door.
'Aquí está la llavecita plateada para la puerta del ático del tercer piso.'
Does the attic even have a proper bed?
'¿El ático siquiera tiene una cama en condiciones?'
Yes, a good wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the house.
'Sí, una buena cama de madera, un escritorio limpio y la mejor vista de la casa.'
Then why do we never rent it to guests?
'¿Entonces por qué nunca se lo alquilamos a los huéspedes?'
Because the stairs are narrow and Arthur keeps old lamp boxes there.
'Porque la escalera es estrecha y Arthur guarda allí cajas viejas de lámparas.'
Only three small boxes! Maybe four!
'¡Solo tres cajas pequeñas! ¡Quizás cuatro!'
We can move four boxes in five minutes. Let us go look right now!
'Podemos mover cuatro cajas en cinco minutos. ¡Vamos a mirar ahora mismo!'
Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the top.
'Subiendo la escalera, gira a la izquierda en el rellano, la última puerta arriba del todo.'
I will bring clean white sheets from the linen closet!
'¡Traeré sábanas blancas limpias del armario de la ropa blanca!'
Come on, race you to the third floor!
'¡Vamos, te echo una carrera hasta el tercer piso!'
Escuchemos otra vez toda la escena a velocidad natural.
Thirty-five minutes! He will write a terrible one star review!
Take a deep breath, Arthur. Nobody has written anything yet.
Here is the small silver key for the third floor attic door.
Does the attic even have a proper bed?
Yes, a good wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the house.
Then why do we never rent it to guests?
Because the stairs are narrow and Arthur keeps old lamp boxes there.
Only three small boxes! Maybe four!
We can move four boxes in five minutes. Let us go look right now!
Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the top.
I will bring clean white sheets from the linen closet!
Come on, race you to the third floor!
Quedan treinta y cinco minutos en el reloj y cuatro cajas en el camino. No te preocupes si alguna expresión pasó rápido; volverán a salir arriba en el tercer piso. Hasta la próxima.
See you soon!
